title: Turn data into a verified report

chapters.title: From an order export to a checked report
chapters.caption: A daily order export becomes a checked JSON report and a written summary. The agent must create and execute the analysis.

chapters.title: What runs where?
chapters.caption: Your worker coordinates through Harakiri. OpenCode and Python run in the sandbox; model inference is external.

chapters.title: Define success before starting the agent
chapters.caption: Paid revenue: 2500 + 19900 + 7200 = 29600 cents. Exclude the refunded order. Keep the input unchanged.

chapters.title: Prepare the Node.js worker
chapters.caption: Install the SDK on your worker. Set the Harakiri API URL and key privately. The sandbox template already contains OpenCode.

chapters.title: Create an isolated OpenCode workspace
chapters.caption: Keep the returned sandbox ID. Wait until running. The 600-second TTL is a fallback; cleanup still runs in finally.

chapters.title: Transfer the input through the SDK
chapters.caption: Upload data, not a prewritten analysis. /workspace is the remote sandbox directory. Retain the local input for verification.

chapters.title: Make the free-model choice explicit
chapters.caption: Pin both main and small models to the free model. Broad tool permissions apply only to this synthetic, disposable demo.

chapters.title: Give the agent the complete task
chapters.caption: The complete prompt specifies input, program, output schema, execution and an unchanged CSV. No hidden instructions.

chapters.title: agentCommand is an ordinary shell string
chapters.caption: run: non-interactive task. --format json: execution events. --model: explicit model. shellQuote keeps the prompt one argument.

chapters.title: Start a tracked background command
chapters.caption: agentCommand runs in /workspace. detached returns a job ID. timeoutMs limits command execution to four minutes.

chapters.title: Wait for completion and inspect the logs
chapters.caption: 260 seconds is the caller waiting budget, not a longer execution limit. Read logs before cleanup. Exit 0 alone is not acceptance.

chapters.title: Inspect real work, not an agent promise
chapters.caption: These are completed tools from the real run. The script checks zero reported model cost; private reasoning is not published.

chapters.title: Retrieve files before destroying the runtime
chapters.caption: Download JSON, summary and original input before termination. contentBase64 is the file envelope, not the agent answer.

chapters.title: Make your application the final judge
chapters.caption: Assert exact totals and unchanged input before saving. The summary must be nonempty; its prose needs separate review.

chapters.title: The verified result is now in your worker
chapters.caption: Verified JSON and summary are saved in your worker. This recording passed; future agent runs must pass the same checks.

chapters.title: Always clean up, including on failure
chapters.caption: finally handles success and failure. Verify terminated. If connectivity prevents cleanup, recover using the sandbox ID and TTL.

editing: Real CLI output replay; condensed SDK excerpts; real UI recordings. Waiting removed. No speed benchmark or voiceover.
